**Finding: MINCOMMIT — compliant (preferred position).**

No minimum purchase or volume commitment is imposed on Sparkling anywhere in the Agreement:

- **§11 Fees** obliges payment only of "the fees as set out in the Fee Schedule" — no committed spend, shortfall or take-or-pay mechanic.
- **§2** additional fees arise only if Sparkling chooses to use the Software beyond the Authorized Locations; **§10(c)** chargeable repairs are usage-triggered — both are pay-for-what-you-order, not commitments.
- **§10** maintenance runs on a renewable one-year term, within the fallback's 12-month boundary in any event.
- **§17(b)** gives Sparkling an unconditional right to terminate on 90 days' notice, so there is no multi-year lock-in (walk-away territory is not engaged).

No redline proposed. Diligence note only: Schedule "A" (Fee Schedule) is not part of the reviewed text — it should be checked for any committed seat/location count or minimum annual spend; perpetual licence-fee instalments would not themselves constitute a minimum commitment.
